Well... I suppose it's my eating. It's just gotten... turned around lately. Some days I don't even remember to have lunch. And then other times, I just stand at the kitchen counter eating crackers or sweets, even though... well, nothing really tastes right anyway.
Aside from changes in your eating, how has your mood been feeling recently?

Well... I suppose it's just been a bit heavy. Mostly in the mornings, anyway. I wake up and... I don't know, there's just this low feeling. It's like the color has already gone out of the day before I even get dressed. I just... well, that's about it, really.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
Well... I suppose it's been a while. This... low, colorless stretch, I mean. It's been with me for about a year and two months, I'd say. Give or take.

Well... I suppose... I don't really know. I haven't really kept track of things like that. It's just... this is how it is right now.
Did anything specific happen in your life around the time you started feeling this way?
No... I don't think so. Just... nothing stands out.
